transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well... I'm on leave from work right now. I, um... I guess I pushed ahead with a new onboarding launch recently. I committed some company money and vendor time before the actual approvals were in place. 

At the time, it just felt... I don't know, bold. Like it was necessary to get things moving. But... yeah, now I'm on leave, and everyone is asking what I was thinking. So... that's why I'm here.
At the time you made those decisions, were you feeling unusually high, energized, or irritable compared with your normal self?

I don't know if I'd use the word "high." I just... for the past few weeks, I felt... I guess, brilliantly alive. Like I was finally going to show leadership what HR can actually be. 

But... yeah, I suppose I was irritable, too. If someone questioned me... even just asking routine budget questions, or wanting small edits... I would get suddenly furious. I just... I didn't have patience for it.
During that time, did you need much less sleep than usual and still feel rested?
I mean... I wasn't sleeping much, I guess. Maybe a few hours a night. But I wasn't really keeping track. I just had a lot to do.
During this period, did you have any beliefs that others said were unrealistic or impossible?
No... I don't think so. I mean, people obviously didn't agree with my timeline for the launch, but... no. I didn't have any strange beliefs or anything. Just the plans for the department. That's it.
During this time, did you hear or see things that other people said were not there?
No. I didn't see or hear anything like that.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
No. I don't... I haven't really had anything like that. Just the usual stress, I suppose.
During that period, did your behavior cause serious problems in your work or social life?

I mean... I guess there were some issues. At work. Just... because of how I handled the launch, and the conflicts we had over it. They, um... they put me on administrative leave. So I'm not managing the HR projects I was leading anymore. They don't really have me doing anything right now.
Before this recent period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt unusually high, energized, or irritable like this?
No, not really. I mean... I've had times where I felt good, or got a lot done, but... nothing like this. Not that I can remember.
